lokele: Imi Yakobo, bɔkɔwa wa Mungu la wa Ngɛnɛ Yesu Masiya, nd’atoseela eba tukela liu la imbale ebasomelakana nda wenda mia.
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, 1:1 to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

lokele: Bitungani yami, atotowakan’ino la bakoteli ba bɔfɔnɔ la bɔfɔnɔ, tangaka nde mbo ende litina lioka ko limɛngɔ lifi,
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, 1:2 when you fall into various temptations,

lokele: eoka osoluwa mbo likɔtɔlɔmu lia lilendelu lianu litoeshel’ino likɔkɔmɛlɛ.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

lokele: Nde machaka likɔkɔmɛlɛ liɔlwɛkɛ mbo ino angɛnɛ ɔlwɛkɛ hɔlɔoɔla wenganeke hele, angoomelo loasɔ angɔlɔmɔi.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

lokele: Nde eya mbo ɔmɔi wanu eomelo wɛlï, afeleke ngo Mungu oyatofaekefa batotina lifaefela, angoimaima, ani wao bofaefomoko inde.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

lokele: Nde afeleke ko la lilendelu, angota fee; eoka oyatotaka fee ende kwa litutu nda liyande elitoeyaeya la elitonyɛngɛnyɛngɛ la lomba.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

lokele: Boto wa bɔfɔnɔ-bo atatanga nde mbo ɛɔlɔkɔ nde yeka ango ɛmɔi ende Ngɛnɛ,
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

lokele: eoka ale ko boto wa betema imbale l’ewa loeyaeyo nda biyaelo yande bitotina.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

lokele: Etungani wa liikami se, aomaleke eoka ya lotalio loande;
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

lokele: nde ewa lifoka, ko l’eoka ya liikami se liande, eoka atosɛɛsɛlɛ kwa lɔfɔtɔtɔ loa elanga.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

lokele: Eoka löwa lososɔswa la efanga ya loao esobɛɛlɛsɛ elanga, limɔ fɔtɔtɔ nda yao bitowɛlɛkɛmɛ se, limɔ wano wa yao botosɛɛsɛlɛ fɛɛ. Ko ongoma ewa lifoka atosɛɛsɛlɛ oko nda kɛndɔ yande.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

lokele: Boto oyatokɔkɔmɔ nda likoteli ende la limɛngɔ fuu, eoka akasilek’inde ndokɔtɔlɔmɔ, inde kofomo iyoyo sha loiko eshatikaka Ngɛnɛ lisakä liofaef’iyo ebatosamak’Inde.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

lokele: Atokɔtɔlɔmɔ boto, ataonga mbo— Isokɔtɔlɔmɔ ko la Mungu angɛnɛ; eoka Mungu atikɔkɔlɛ ndokɔtɔlɔmɔ nda njasɔ ibe, la Inde angɛnɛ aitososhela boto angɔmɔi;
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

lokele: kongo ko boto la boto asososhelomo ko la yɛmɛ yande angɛnɛ ebitokokɛl’inde kwa swi, la bitɔɔngɔl’inde kwa nyama.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

lokele: Lamao mbisa yɛmɛ eyesoaelo lieme, koota litwanelo, la mbisa akaelyeke litwanelo, liao koota ngo liwa.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

lokele: Olimbomöko, Bitungani yami!
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

lokele: Bafaefi batotina la bɛkɛɛ bitoti ebile bilau l’ebisoeliama, bisosekwa olo nda Use ende Sango wa baangangi oyaitokikwakikwa ango sinyo, la angwɛnɛ ango ndembe ya likikwi.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

lokele: Asangaka ndokel’iso bana bande ko la Lioi lia wewe, mbo iso toyaleke sumbu eula ya yaatotina ebikakelek’Inde mbisa. Boyaeli wa wewe wa bana ba Mungu
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

lokele: Bitungani ebisamomu lami, luwaka nde lioi-li, mbo— Boto la boto umamaka ndoka, nde ongaka l’imɔngi, somaka imɔ ko l’imɔngi kongo;
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

lokele: eoka lisomi lia balomboki liitoeshel’iso liengani lia Mungu.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

lokele: Eokao siamesaka njasɔ bitotina ya bɔwɛwɛ la sheteseli sha bobe bototina, limɔ aelaka wɛndi ebosolɔɔmɔ nda betema yanu ko la liikami se, eoka bosokɔkɔlɔ ndouwesa belimo yanu.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls. 1:21

lokele: Nde litesaka wɛndi, oyalëke ko ebatokaka la batoi kongo ndolimbaka betema yanu angɛnɛ.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

lokele: Eya to mbo boto eokaka wɛndi, angolitesa wao, engani nde kwa boto oyatotichaka bɔmbɔ ewaotomoko lande, nda wɛli wa talatala,
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

lokele: limɔ ani asolembeel’inde angɛnɛ, inde kosekwa, inde koosala kwa ayal’inde.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

lokele: Kongo ko inde oyatowɛlɛkɛ Bikela baiso, biko bikela ebisɔɔlwa l’ebisosɛlɛ boto iote angɛnɛ, limɔ ekɔkɔmɛlɛ kɔkɛ, angoosala ebisokak’inde, kangä bolitesi nda bekeeli yande, ambo boto ona atoyaimwaka la limɛngɔ nda yao ebitokel’inde.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

lokele: Boto kotanga mbo ayali oyatolitekesa njasɔ ya Mungu, ani aitoaesa lolamɛ se, inde nd’atolimbaka botema wande angɛnɛ, la lilitesi liande lile ngo ko wawa.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

lokele: Lilitesi lia njasɔ ya Mungu elile litanu, angwɛnɛ litwanelo ango limɔi nda baiso ba Mungu Sango lile ngo ko ano, mbo ndotingakanaka l’eba tika ya sango l’eba tika ya batolome nda mbile ya bifembi yau la ndoyala la botanu, angwɛnɛ ango liälö lia wenda-bo.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

lokele: Bitungani yami, okwelakwelëke biɔmbɔ ya bato nda lilendelu liolendelo Yesu Masiya, Ngɛnɛ wasu wa tala.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

lokele: Eoka boto ɛɔtɔ nda ɛsɔngɔmɛlɔ yanu ani awati toketi twa loela la bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ finɛ, limɔ boto wasi wa iuwe ɛɔtɔ ani awati ko bisinda ya baɔmbɔ̈,
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, 2:2 and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

lokele: limɔ asolɛlia ino boto oyawati bisinda ya bɔfɛkɔ la otoonga lande mbo— Yalaka sumbu se eya elela elau; nde, ende oto wa iuwe, ino mbo— Emalaka onamona, ango ko mbo— Yalaka se nda batindi bami,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

lokele: ¿Oitotwanesa bato ongoma la oisokinjwa bakomyi ba baenyeli babe?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

lokele: Toka, Bitungani ebisamomu lami. ¿Mungu aisoaa eba touwe nda wenda-bo mbo bayaleke bafoka nda lilendelu la mbo basangoleke isosha nda Bɔkɔta ewatikak’Inde lisakä liofaef’iyo ebasosam’Inde?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

lokele: Nde ino nd’asosɛɔlɔ boto-yo wa iuwe; ¿Bafoka baisokakales’ino la owau, baitosuliak’ino nda ekomyelo ya njasɔ?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

lokele: ¿Iyo ana baisomɔlɔkɔ Lina lia tala elitangelomu ino?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

lokele: Nde ango bokɔcha ekela ya Bɔkɔta kwa asɔnɔmɔkɔ nda Lokasa, mbo— Samaka boyalani laɛ kwa aɛ angɛnɛ, ongoma otokela olau.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” Leviticus 19:18 you do well.

lokele: Kongo ko eya mbo bokwelakwela biɔmbɔ ya bato, ani osokwa litwanelo, la ongoma Bikela bisof’ino se mbo batefokoli ba yao.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

lokele: Eoka boto oyasokɔcha Bikela bitoti, nde kotwanelo nda ekela ko ɛmɔi, ambo asofomo se nda bitotina.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

lokele: Eoka Inde oyaongaka mbo— Ochwëke nyongo, aongak’imɔ mbo— Olëke boto; eya to mbo, otichweke nyongo, nde osoola boto, ambo wende botefoli wa Bikela.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” Exodus 20:14 also said, “Do not commit murder.” Exodus 20:13 Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

lokele: Ongaka to la kelakaka bekeeli kwa bato ebakatelomoko ko la Bikela ya toote.
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

lokele: Eoka boto oyatiwɛlɛkɛ bato basi shota, ona atoatelomo njasɔ l’angwɛnɛ to shota; shota sisoomala mbo sisolonga nda likomyi. Ebitoimel’iso la ebitokel’iso
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

lokele: ¿Bitungani yami, boto eonga mbo ale la liimeli, ani atikele yeka yokɔcha liao, boni to bolau? ¿Mbo liimeli lina lisokɔkɔlɔ ndouwes’inde?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

lokele: Boto wanu, ango ko otolome, ango ko otomali, eyala la boeno wa bisinda yowata la bieka yolaka lise la lise,
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

lokele: ɔmɔi wanu koonga lau mbo— Takɛndɛkɛ la wɛlï, ɔtɔkɔ sumbu bosa, okaneloko bieka; nde otifek’iyo yeka ebisoeno bindo yau, boni to bolau anyo?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

lokele: Liimeli imɔ ko ongoma, eya mbo litikɔchɔmɔ la bekeeli, ambo lisowa liao angɛnɛ.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

lokele: Kongo ko boto ɔmɔi koonga mbo— Aɛ wende la liimeli, nde imi yende boto oyatokela bolau; tambaka’mi liimeli liaɛ elitikɔchɔmɔ la bekeeli, limɔ imi nd’atotamb’aɛ liimeli liami ko la bekeeli yami.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

lokele: Osoimela mbo Mungu ende ko Ɔmwito; osokela olau, nde belimo ebe bisoimela imɔ la bisotalimwa.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

lokele: Boto w’ebebel ¿Olɛmbi nde ndoluwa litina lia lioi-li, mbo liimeli elitikɔchɔmɔ la bekeeli lile ngo wawa?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

lokele: ¿Mbo Abalayama tata wasu, atilongesomoko ko la bekeeli yande eyasɛlɛk’inde wana wande ako Isaka nda etumbelo?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

lokele: Osɔɛnɛ to mbo liimeli losungana la bekeeli yande la mbo liimeli lisɔɔlwa ko la bekeeli yande;
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

lokele: la ongoma Lokasa loa Mungu lokɔchɔmɔ ani aongaka loao mbo— Abalayama alendeloko Mungu la liimeli liande liatangomokö end’inde mbo liengani, la inde lotangomoko Wina wa Mungu.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” Genesis 15:6 and he was called the friend of God.

lokele: Ongoma osɔɛnɛ to mbo boto atolongesomo ko la bekeeli yande la inga ko l’eoka ya liimeli kongo.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

lokele: ¿Ko ongoma Lahaba botomali wa bolëfë, atialongesomoko ko la bekeeli yande, ani anyangelak’inde ebatomomoko tɔtɔmbi limɔ inde loinol’iyo ko la mboka yasi?
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

lokele: Eoka bindo ebisosɛnyana la bolimo bisoya ko bolyo, bisowa; ko ongoma liimeli elisosɛnyana la bekeeli lisowa ndowa.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

lokele: Bitungani yami, bato wike banu batayalaka baekesi, eoka kwa aluw’ino mbo iso baekesi totoatelomo njasɔ la likomyi lioeta elia basi l’owau.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

lokele: Eoka iso batotina totokwaka batwanelo wike, la boto oyatikwe litwanelo nda lioi liande, ambo ende elalaka wewe oyatokɔkɔlɔ ndoaesa lolamɛ se la bindo bitoti imɔ.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

lokele: Totaka biwachelo nda bɛnɔkɔ ya funda mbo balitesek’iso, limɔ totokɛndɛkɛsɛl’iyo bindo bitotina.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

lokele: Tɛnɛk’imɔ ko bitumbe ya lofofo; ango biyali bifi fafo, la bitotinjakomo la fomba ya bolengi finɛ, nde bitowachelomo ko la kai ɛkɛkɛ kongo olo atosanga oyayali nda wendo.
english: Behold, 3:4 the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

lokele: Lolamɛ ko ongoma, lole elëngö ɛkɛkɛ ya bindo, kongo ko lotofɔlɔ loasɔ loa likama. Tɛnɛ, lokëke loa liäla, ambo lɔkɛkɛ, lotofechaka ngonda efi fafo.
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

lokele: Lolamɛ lole bösä, la atiteni ya bilëngö ya bindo yasu lotobebesa betema la likama lia bobe ebototumesa bindo; lolamɛ lotoanesa lotunyo loa liwawi-li, la loao angɛnɛ lotoana la bösä wa Ngehena.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna. 3:6

lokele: Eoka kanda bitotina ya nyama, la nɔli, la tolandalanda nda nyɛlɛ, la nyama bitotina ya balia bitokakalesomo la bisosila ndokakalesomo kakala ko la balomboki,
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

lokele: nde angwɛnɛ bolomboki wokɔkɔlɔ ndokakalesa lolamɛ. Loao loende bobe eboti bokomyomo, losotuma la lisäkä lia liwa.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

lokele: Totoinela Ngɛnɛ Mungu ako Sango ko la lolamɛ, la loao imɔ totomɔlɔkɔ bato ebasokelomo la liluku lia Mungu.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

lokele: Liineli la limɔli nd’atokuswaka ko nda bɔnɔkɔ ɔmɔi. Bitungani yami, lotiengane mbo loyaleke ongoma.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

lokele: ¿Mbo isolo sitokusola balia ba lɔɛtɛ l’eba likase ko la liöndo limwito?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

lokele: ¿Mbo bosau kokɔkɔlɔ ndoota mbila, Bitungani yami, kwa mbo toyayöliki koota sau? Mbayɔ, la balia ba bokwa imɔ angokɔkɔlɔ ndokusola balia ba lɔɛtɛ. Wɛlï wa Use la ewa wenda-bo
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

lokele: ¿Ndai wanu ayali nde boto wa wɛlï la bokwafi? Boto ona ɛnɛsɛkɛ to basi bekeeli yande nda boyaeli wa botema sambo wa wɛlï ebototimbana lande.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

lokele: Nde eya mbo boyalaka la lisiela la lisakani lia bosho nda betema yanu, oongëke la ifaala la nanga ebitokufesa momongo.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

lokele: Wao boti to wɛlï ebokuswi nde nda Use, kangä ewa wenda-bo, ewa bindo, l’ewa belimo ebe;
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

lokele: eoka olo ayali ko lisiela la lisakani lia bosho, ko omao loeyaeyo la bobe wa bɛfɔnɔ bitotina.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

lokele: Nde wɛlï ebokuswi nde nda Use wende oso la botanu, limɔ wende la lilatemi la bɔfɔu, bosotuma la shota la bekeeli ya booto, boti l’ikwelakwela la bolimbakeli.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

lokele: Eula ya boyaeli wa lilatemi etotwomo ko la bato ebasolɔɔ imɔ ko boyaeli wa lilatemi.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

lokele: ¿Bita la bawesani ebayali lanu basekwi nde lonima to? Biisosekwa nda biɛmɛ ebisotukatukana lanu mbo bikakaleseke betema yanu?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

lokele: Wende la yɛmɛ ya biengo nde otiɔlɛ, otoola la otololaka nde otikɔkɔlɛ ndosɛlɛ yao, otowesakana, otonana bita; nde otiɔlɛ eoka otifele yao.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

lokele: Otofelaka la oitoaela eoka otofelaka nde efinole ko mbo osileseke yao nda yɛmɛ yanu.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

lokele: Wende bato ba nyongo! ¿Otiluwe mbo lisaɔ lia eba wenda lile wiyani la Mungu? Eokao oyakasangeke osukana lisaɔ lia eba wenda-bo ambo asokwa wiyani la Mungu.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

lokele: ¿Elua otangi nde mbo Lokasa loa Mungu losoonga ko liongëla mbo— Bolimo ewayalesak’Inde nda betema yasu bosolol’iso la bokelë?
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

lokele: Nde Mungu atofaekef’iso booto woetela, kwa asoonga imɔ lokasa mbo— Mungu atofekela eba bɛmɛtɔ, nde atofaekefa eba liɔndwi se ko booto wande.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.” Proverbs 3:34

lokele: Eokao litesaka ko Mungu kongo, fekelaka Satana, limɔ atokwel’ino botili.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

lokele: Sishanaka tina la Mungu, limɔ Inde atosishana tina lanu. Solaka besamba yanu, ino bato ba batwanelo la tanesaka betema yanu, ino ba betema imbale!
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

lokele: Okaka tokɛnɛnɛ, lelaka, wɛlɛkɛ foo se; twɛlɔ etososɛk’ino, tokinjweke ndeli la limɛngɔ likinjweke ko tolöi.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

lokele: Ɔndɔkɔlɔkɔ betema yanu se nda baiso ba Mungu, limɔ Inde elataliak’ino likolo. Beimo la bakakanelo ende eb’Etanda
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

lokele: Bitungani, osɛɔkɔlɔnɛ̈kɛ! Oyatosɛɔkɔlɔ etungani, kwa oyatoata loasɔ loa etungani yande, ambo asosɛɔkɔlɔ Bikela la asoataka Bikela. Nde eya mbo boataka Bikela, ambo oti imɔ bolitesi wa Bikela, kangä wataki wa yao.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

lokele: Oyataka Bikela la Bokomyi wa Bikela ale ko Ɔmwito, ako Inde kongo oyatokɔkɔlɔ ndouwesa la ndosɛɛsɛlɛsɛ bato. ¿Aɛ wende to ndai oyatoataka boyalani laɛ loasɔ?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, ino ebatoonga mbo— Ango ko louse, ango lɛlɛngɔ tɔkɛkɛ nda bokenge boko asisa, tolaingalaka omao ko mwaka ɔmɔi okatimbesa bokalala la tolaɔlɔkɔ bondanda;
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

lokele: kongo ko wende ebatiluwe kɔni ani atoyala liwawi lianu lɛlɛngɔ. Eoka wende kwa liumba elisɔɛnɛlɛ ko sinyo sha mbile, lamao kosɛɛsɛlɛ.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

lokele: Nda lifa lia baoi bana, ino koonga mbo— Eya mbo Ngɛnɛ ɛlɛmbɛ ongoma, iso koyala la liwawi, iso kokela e-loasɔ-lo, ango ko lona.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

lokele: Nde kwani ino nd’atofaala la bɔmɛtɔ wanu la bɔmɛtɔ bototi-bo bole ko bobe.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

lokele: Eokao, oyatoluwa ko ndokela olau, nde angokela wao, ani lona kotangomo obe end’inde.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

lokele: Tɛnɛ ngo, ino bafoka. Lelaka, ulaulaka loasɔ loa bemusi ebikayek’end’ino.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

lokele: Bieto yanu bisofɔndɔkɔ la bisinda yanu bisobeba la fomboli;
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

lokele: mbela la falata yanu bisoliakama la batalɛ la batalɛ bana batotikala kwa tuka yof’ino se, la bao batofechaka lokomba loanu kwa bösä; ososɔnjaka bondanda nda bacho ba liko.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, bieto ya basali banu ebatwaka eula ya bilanga yanu, biko yao ebisɔnɔkɔlɔ ino end’iyo, yao to bisoamamel’ino la bamiki ba ebatwaka eula yanu basɔɔtɔ ko nda batoi ba Mungu Ngɛnɛ wa Bikuke.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies. 5:4

lokele: Ono nda wenda walaka bieka ya bonuku la wakaneloko yɛmɛ yanu, watumesaka betema yanu l’enika la lise lia liömä lifi.
english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

lokele: Osofaefa ewa liengani se, osool’inde; atifekel’ino ango sinyo.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

lokele: Eokao, Bitungani, owëke esole ko nda bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ wasu. Tɛnɛ ngo, ngɛnɛ wa elanga atoumbakela eula ya tuma etosɔlɛmb’inde finɛ, aitowaka esole ko nd’akatɔnɛkɛ mbula ya biää la mbula ya bɔtɔkɔ.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

lokele: Ino imɔ owëke esole, kɔkɔmɛsɛkɛ betema yanu eoka bayelo ba Ngɛnɛ wasu basamboya tina.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

lokele: Bitungani, okimakimanëke mbo otafomo se nda liataki. Tɛnɛ, Wataki akoemala nda bome.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

lokele: Bitungani, böluka etichelo eoka ya winikɔlo wa bato ebatiawaka esole, tichaka Batɔndɔli ebaongaka ko nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

lokele: Tɛnɛ, toisotanga bato ana ebakɔkɔmɔkɔ la bofiili, mbo Eba Limɛngɔ. Osookak’imɔ loasɔ loa bɔkɔkɔmu wa Yobo, la osɔɛnɛ lisangi lia Mungu eoka yande, la ani Ngɛnɛ Mungu asotuma fuu la ngandi la shota. Bikanɔ la baölo ba wewe
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

lokele: Bitungani yami, loasɔ lɔmɔi losolongela to, loko mbo— Otinyëke ekanɔ, ango ko la Use, ango la se, ango la ekanɔ ya kanda yasi; nde Eingo eyetosingwak’ino, eyaleke ngo ko Eingo, la Mbayo ngo ko Mbayo kongo, mbo otafomo se nda liataki. Lisomboli liouwesa bato basi
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy. 5:12

lokele: ¿Ɔmɔi wanu atoka wale? Asombokoleke to! ¿Ɔmɔi wanu nd’asoyaimwa olau? Achweke to bɔɛlɛ!
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

lokele: ¿Ɔmɔi wanu ayali nde la loo? Ateke biange ya Etanda lioi, basombokoelek’inde, balɔkɛsɛk’inde baita nda lina lia Ngɛnɛ;
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

lokele: la lisomboli lia liimeli litouwesa boto ona wa lokambo la Ngɛnɛ atosäsesa nd’inde liasi. Eya mbo asokela batwanelo, bemɛsɛlɛmɔkɔ inde.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

lokele: Sanokolanaka to batwanelo banu, sombokoelanaka mbo bosasesomoko säsosäso. Lisomboli lia boto wa liengani litokɔkɔlɔ likuwa lia likama.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

lokele: Eliya aaka boto wa liluku kwa eliasu, la inde losombola ndosombola mbo mbula etatɔnɛkɛ, la mbula etiatɔnɔkɔ nda nyɛlɛ ko la miaka bisatɔ la tengai liambɛ,
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

lokele: limɔ inde losombola liasi la buse lotɔnɛsɛ mbula la nyɛlɛ lɔɔ̈tɔ̈ tuma twa yao. Liinoli lia boto wa batwanelo
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

lokele: Bitungani yami, eya mbo boto wanu esekwaka nda mboka ya wewe la wasi koinol’inde liasi,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

lokele: aluweke mbo boto oyasoinola boto mbo asekweke nda mboka ya efinole, ambo atouwesa bolimo wande nda liwa la atoliaka ambɔlɛ wa batwanelo.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.
